description: This file defines notification forwarding policies, including filtering modes, quiet hours, and rate limiting for notifications in an Android app.

classes.name: NotificationPackageFilterMode
classes.description: An enum representing filter modes (allowlist or blocklist) for notification packages, with a method to create enum instances from raw string values.

classes.name: NotificationForwardingPolicy
classes.description: A data class encapsulating various settings for forwarding notifications, including filter mode, package list, quiet hours, and rate limiting.

classes.name: NotificationBurstLimiter
classes.description: A class implementing per-minute rate limiting for notifications, ensuring no more than a specified number of events occur within a minute.

methods.name: fromRawValue
methods.description: Creates an instance of NotificationPackageFilterMode from a raw string value, defaulting to Blocklist.

methods.name: allowsPackage
methods.description: Determines if a package is allowed based on the filter mode and package set.

methods.name: isWithinQuietHours
methods.description: Checks if a given epoch time falls within the defined quiet hours period.

methods.name: normalizeLocalHourMinute
methods.description: Normalizes a raw string into a standardized 'HH:MM' format if it matches the expected pattern.

methods.name: parseLocalHourMinute
methods.description: Parses a string time in 'HH:MM' format into total minutes past midnight.

methods.name: allow
methods.description: Determines if a notification event is allowed based on rate limiting constraints within a one-minute window.
